description: Systems Engineering - US Regulated Markets Team

Designed and implemented a ServiceNow Virtual Agent chatbot powered by Azure OpenAI and Now LLM, to autonomously process artifact transfer requests from commercial to regulated environments under strict compliance constraints.

Built a modular multi-agent framework, applying agent design foundations (model, tools, instructions) to handle distinct workloads (Docker images, GitLab repositories, Kubernetes clusters), enabling zero-touch transfers, real-time artifact querying, and future extensibility.

Developed and prompt-engineered specialized AI agents and tools including scripts, record operations, and LLM workflows to execute transfer creation, error handling, and reprocessing logic, aligning with best practices for tool orchestration and guardrails.

Reduced artifact transfer time by ~100%, cutting manual team effort from ~3 hours to instantaneous user-triggered execution, while providing real-time visibility and control directly through the chatbot.
Developer Productivity - Tools Engineering Team
Developed and optimized an internal Java code analysis tool to search for RegEx patterns in the company's codebase to identify poor coding practices and improve software maintenance and quality.

Integrated Jenkins with the ServiceNow platform by programming multiple scripts in JavaScript to automate the execution of Jenkins pipelines and ensure accurate data insertion of analyzer results into the appropriate tables.
Implemented an audit tracking system to monitor and log the lifecycle of analyzer requests, ensuring comprehensive visibility.
Reduced analyzer delivery time by >90% from ~1.5 months to <1 week by streamlining repetitive analysis requests.
Collaborated with stakeholders of $2B law firm to understand client business objectives and develop 10+ inbound and outbound third-party system integrations with the Salesforce platform.
Analyzed 100+ Java classes and queried objects using SQL to determine data quality and integration effectiveness.

Executed Salesforce security health check and code scan and compiled resulting 1000+ data points in Excel for streamlined data analysis of platform security risks, duplicate management, and outdated web components.
